reviews: Security and privacy review of cache contents and redaction guarantees
Validation correctness review of dependency coverage, invalidation, and fail-toward-run behavior

findings.summary: .projectops/validation-cache/ is not in .gitignore. Cache entries contain no secrets (only validator names, SHA-256 hex hashes, booleans, integers, ISO timestamps), but accidental commits would be repository residue. The worker grant does not cover .gitignore — the owner must add the entry.

validate-speed-validation-cache.cjs exists but is NOT in validate-all.cjs's MODULES list. The cache correctness proof does not run during standard validation. The worker grant does not cover validate-all.cjs — the owner must add the registration.

Node execution was denied in this session. The benchmark tooling (projectos/speed/benchmark.cjs) is structurally sound and targets all three timing thresholds, but the acceptance criterion 'benchmarked at 2 seconds or less' requires a live measurement. validate-no-secrets and validate-speed-validation-cache were also not executed. The tooling is ready; the proof requires an execution-approved session.

Static review confirms fail-toward-run for all eight specified conditions: unknown coverage (empty inputPaths → coverage 'none' → null), known changed (input hash diverges → key mismatch), corrupt entries (JSON.parse failure → null), unreadable inputs (hashFile/hashDirectory → null → 'partial' → null), version mismatch (schemaVersion check → null), environment mismatch (envHash includes node+platform+arch → key diverges), expired entries (>7 days → null), no input declaration (not in inputMap → empty → 'none'). The standalone validator validates all six conditions independently.

validate-all.cjs has zero imports from projectos/speed/. cached-runner.cjs is an alternative runner. clear() removes the directory; every cache miss falls through to running the real validator. Deleting the cache can reduce performance but never validation correctness.

Two write paths exist: buildEntry() (7 keys: schemaVersion, validator, key, passed, errorCount, createdAt, lastUsedAt) and buildSuiteEntry() (adds kind:'suite', head commit SHA, results[] of {name, passed, errorCount}). The key field is always a 64-char SHA-256 hex digest. No file contents, error messages, provider data, prompts, responses, or secrets ever enter the stored data. walkDir skips node_modules, .git, target, and validation-cache.

validate-all.cjs is unchanged and has no dependency on any speed/ module. The cached runner is an alternative, not a replacement. --no-cache forces a full uncached run. Full uncached validation remains authoritative and is never bypassed.

The ≤5s 'proof/data-only validation' target is documented in benchmark.cjs's header but has no dedicated benchmark measurement. It is implicitly covered by the per-validator cache path for data-only validators, but no separate timing isolation exists. A dedicated benchmark run category would make the criterion independently provable.

The suite-level fast path (≤2s target) requires git.clean === true AND git.head === cached head. Any uncommitted change invalidates the suite cache. The cache directory itself is correctly excluded from the cleanliness check (porcelain status filters lines under .projectops/validation-cache/), preventing a self-defeating cycle where caching makes the tree dirty.
